Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Pedantic old me just realized something about the card
"Legacy of Pander".. In its current wording, it says that
each non-titled Pander gets one vote.

Rulebook says "If you have a vote, it's considered a title".
So.. each non-titled Pander gains a vote. And then by
having a vote, they have a title.. so they lose the vote..
so they gain it back again.. ad infinitum..
Whether they have a vote or not is in a quantum state ;)

I haven't seen the old wording, but I'm assuming it says
each non-titled Pander *gains* one vote, and thereby
presumed stackable.

For the same rulebook-citation as above, though, in seriousness,
it wouldn't be stackable (unless the original wording didn't
have the "non-titled" part). By having one vote, they
now have a title.
